expected_basis: Native VNET TCP SACK sysctl, read before and after each run; outgoing SYN-ACK rules and dummynet counters

impairment.delay_profile: 128 empirical uniform samples interpolated from 15 to 25 ms
impairment.scope: Only outgoing TCP443 SYN-ACKs to the explicit private source; control TCP18067 bypasses impairment

collection.reset: Measurement listeners reopened and native SACK/condition set before each run; independent per-flow randomized tokens
collection.reserved_policy: Second fresh VNET configuration allocated before either fixture is measured; frozen algorithm and protocol; no tuning from reserved outcomes
collection.reason_for_new_registration: The original 256 MB concurrent 588-run study suffered a native kernel panic; retain it separately with all invalid/missing outcomes. Fresh sequential study after memory correction; no pooled acceptance or causal-fix claim.

diagnostics.meaning: Descriptive temporal flags only; lack of flags cannot establish IID or stationarity

limitations: Two fresh VNET TCP stacks on one FreeBSD kernel and one macOS source; configuration-reserved coverage is not physically independent held-out validation
Exact binomial confidence bounds and numerical gates are conditional on IID Bernoulli sampling, which this experiment cannot establish
Strict complete-pair inference stays unresolved under loss; all planned invalid, missing and unresolved outcomes remain in denominators
Direct private IPv4/IPv6 only; Linux corpus supplies proxy/NAT fixtures; no BSD NAT, proxy, routed IPv6 or native FreeBSD Nyxr backend validation
One active fixture at a time on shared source/VM resources; per-child CPU/RSS and RTT remain descriptive, not calibrated performance
Original VM TCP setting/default routes/firewall rules remain unchanged; only temporary VNET rules, links, read-only jail mounts and owned modules are removed
VM RAM and collection concurrency both changed after the failed study; this cannot identify which change affects stability or establish a kernel fix
